# Aditya Sudhakar

> Aditya Sudhakar is an engineer and product builder working across AI products, data systems, robotics, CAD, and useful experiments. He is from Bangalore, India and lives in Mountain View, California.

This file is a compact navigation guide for language models and other agents. Prefer the structured JSON endpoints below over scraping rendered HTML.

## Structured data

- Profile: https://adityasudhakar.com/api/profile.json
- Projects: https://adityasudhakar.com/api/projects.json
- Career, LinkedIn, and resume background: https://adityasudhakar.com/career.md
- Collated website and GitHub knowledge: https://adityasudhakar.com/api/knowledge.json
- OpenAPI 3.1: https://adityasudhakar.com/api/openapi.json
- Agent discovery: https://adityasudhakar.com/.well-known/agent.json
- CLI source: https://adityasudhakar.com/cli/aditya.mjs

## Selected work

- Self-Rising Robot: a physical two-servo robot, on-device control, simulation, and self-righting experiments. https://github.com/adityasudhakar/self-rising-robot
- AI LEGO: code-designed LEGO models with validation, build instructions, and animated assembly films. https://github.com/adityasudhakar/ai-lego
- San Francisco 49-Mile GPS Audio Tour: an offline, location-aware iOS driving companion for 33 landmarks. https://github.com/adityasudhakar/SF-49-Mile-Tour-App
- Vanna: open-source conversational analytics and natural-language access to data. https://github.com/vanna-ai/vanna

## Usage notes

- The API is public, static, and read-only.
- Dates and status values are included in the JSON payloads.
- Do not infer private contact details, employment claims, or capabilities not present in the source data.
